summary: Up-to-date rule for required checks on main: strict off (BEHIND merges, main-health-monitor is the backstop) vs keep strict with reconciler re-arm

options.description: Keep STRICT=true; reconciler re-arms and update-branches disarmed green PRs; docs corrected to match
Set STRICT=false; BEHIND PRs merge as-is; main-health-monitor catches a bad main; docs and script agree on false

body: Workflow audit 2026-10-28: docs/operations/merge-without-queue.md says strict=false while scripts/sync-branch-protection.sh sets STRICT=true; with strict on every merge disarms the other green PRs and nothing re-arms them. AISDLC-1097 implements the option named here. Strict off loosens a branch-protection control (weakening), so it is operator-chosen, never self-applied.
